verdict.rationale: Postmark's API exposes message search, stats, bounce, and template endpoints that could be scripted to pull data out in JSON, and retention is configurable, but there is no documented bulk 'export all your data' feature or explicit open-format full-account export/download tool. missing for 10: a dedicated data-export/download-all-account-data feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) full export documentation, and confirmation that historical data beyond retention window is portable.
